scan_metadata.exclusion_note: SHFA's and FNEL's own documented pre-move report windows (2026-05-28..2026-06-18 and 2026-03-22..2026-04-24) were excluded from matching -- they are the source cases, not out-of-sample evidence.
scan_metadata.fp2_duplication_note: Fingerprint 2's raw scan produces multiple match records for the same (symbol, trigger_date) when several nearby prior breakout days each independently re-detect the same underlying quiet-build window (911 unique trigger events -> 2762 raw records is NOT true for FP1, which had zero duplication; FP2 raw=2762 records collapse to 941 unique (symbol, trigger_date) pairs). All summary statistics in fingerprint_scan_results.md for Fingerprint 2 use the DEDUPED set (941 events, keeping one record per unique symbol+trigger_date, first occurrence) as the primary/headline numbers, with raw (all 2762) also reported for comparison. This file contains the full RAW match list (every record the scan produced) for both fingerprints, unmodified.
